description:
Export project schema as an OWL ontology (Turtle): owl:Class per Type, Datatype/ObjectProperty per
Element with domain/range, rdfs:subClassOf inheritance, cardinality restrictions preserving
required/array-ness, SKOS concept schemes per Taxonomy, and owl:equivalentClass/Property from
cross-standard mappings. Anything OWL cannot express is reported as '# lossiness:' comments at the
top of the document instead of being silently dropped.
name: export_owl
title: Export OWL (Turtle)
